content.short: Solpad is a launchpad on the Solana blockchain for NFT projects, enabling tokenization, sale, and distribution of NFTs.
content.description: Solpad is an NFT launchpad built on the Solana network designed to support NFT projects from concept to market. It aims to provide a smooth experience for creators and collectors by enabling the tokenization of NFTs, the sale of those tokens, and their distribution on Solana. By focusing on these core capabilities—tokenization, sale, and distribution—Solpad seeks to streamline the process of launching NFT initiatives and connecting creators and collectors within the Solana ecosystem.
content.meta: Solpad is a platform on Solana that serves as a launchpad for NFT projects. Discover Solpad and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
